; ghostbuster-settings.qmd
; Delay ghost busting when opening and closing device Settings and document settings (PDF/notebook/ebook)
; so the destination view finishes rendering before the refresh

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    TRAVERSE Item#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Timer {
                id: settingsOpenedTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    ghostBuster.forceClearNow("Settings opened");
                }
            }
        }

        REPLACE onOpened WITH {
            function onOpened(configuration) {
                settingsOpenedTimer.restart();

                root.windowNavigator.open("retail/window/retail-restricted", {
                    accept: () => {},
                    reject: () => { root.close() }
                });

                const {action, index} = configuration;
                if (action && action === "showSubscription") {
                    contentItem.showSubscription();
                    return;
                }
                if (action && action === "showCloudSettings") {
                    _selectedPage = SettingsModel.SettingsPage.Cloud;
                    return;
                }

                _selectedPage = index ?? SettingsModel.SettingsPage.General;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/SettingsWindow.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick 2.0
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Timer {
                id: settingsClosedGhostTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    ghostBuster.forceClearNow("Settings closed");
                }
            }
        }

        REPLACE onVisibleChanged WITH {
            onVisibleChanged: {
                if (!visible) {
                    settingsClosedGhostTimer.restart();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/library/ui/qml/EditDocumentWindow.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick 2.0
    IMPORT com.remarkable 1.0
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool wasOpened: false

            Timer {
                id: editDocClosedGhostTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    EPFramebuffer.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }

        REBUILD onOpened
            LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \const { documentId } = args;\ INSERT STREAM \ root.wasOpened = true;\
        END REBUILD

        INSERT {
            onVisibleChanged: {
                if (!visible && root.wasOpened) {
                    root.wasOpened = false;
                    editDocClosedGhostTimer.restart();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
